summary.text: Leo Felix is a Democratic state representative who has represented Rhode Island House of Representatives District 61 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her under the name Leonela Felix and her profession as attorney.

paragraphs.text: Felix was born in Boston, Massachusetts, and has lived in Pawtucket, Rhode Island.

She graduated from Charles E. Shea High School in 2005, earned an associate degree from the Community College of Rhode Island in 2011, and received degrees in justice studies and sociology from Rhode Island College in 2013, followed by a J.D. in 2018.
Felix's career experience includes working as the ethics education coordinator in the legal department of the City of Providence and as policy director with Progreso Latino.
